messages.author: 1618b6fb669a2ac6
messages.subject: log scale after scale_x_log10()
parts:
Hello,

I'd like to plot some data on a log-log scale (see example below). It works but the values on the axis are shown as 1 and 1000 instead of 10^0 and 10^3 (that is, on the computer I am working on now. On my home computer it shows the labels I would like to get). How do I change this and how do I adjust the number of labels printed on the axis without specifying all of them in a vector?

Thanks,

Math

DT = read.table(textConnection("    degree  count
1       1  4488
2       2   510
3       5    29
4       3   130
5      24     1
6       4    71
7      10     3
8       6    12
9      12     1
10     16     1
11      9     2
12     13     1
13     19     1
14      7     3
15      8     2"),head=TRUE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

ggplot(DT, aes(y = count, x = degree)) + 
geom_point() +
xlab("Degree") +
ylab("Count") +
scale_x_log10() + 
scale_y_log10() +
opts(legend.position = "none")

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: log scale after scale_x_log10()
parts:
On 6/28/2012 12:04 PM, MdV wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I'd like to plot some data on a log-log scale (see example below). It works
> but the values on the axis are shown as 1 and 1000 instead of 10^0 and 10^3
> (that is, on the computer I am working on now. On my home computer it shows
> the labels I would like to get). How do I change this and how do I adjust
> the number of labels printed on the axis without specifying all of them in
> a vector?
>
> Thanks,
>
> Math
>
> DT = read.table(textConnection(" degree count
> 1 1 4488
> 2 2 510
> 3 5 29
> 4 3 130
> 5 24 1
> 6 4 71
> 7 10 3
> 8 6 12
> 9 12 1
> 10 16 1
> 11 9 2
> 12 13 1
> 13 19 1
> 14 7 3
> 15 8 2"),head=TRUE,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
>
> ggplot(DT, aes(y = count, x = degree)) +
> geom_point() +
> xlab("Degree") +
> ylab("Count") +
> scale_x_log10() +
> scale_y_log10() +
> opts(legend.position = "none")
>

Change your scale calls to:

scale_x_log10(labels=math_format(format=log10)) +
scale_y_log10(labels=math_format(format=log10)) +

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University
